price: Varies by item (Typically ₹20 to ₹50 per token for packaged food items; Teertham is provided free of charge).
timings: Available daily during regular operational hours (6:00 AM – 1:00 PM and 3:00 PM – 8:00 PM).
location: Dedicated physical Prasadam sales counters located within the main temple exit courtyard area.
description: The temple kitchen actively prepares and distributes sacred Laddu, Pulihora (Tamarind Rice), and Vada to pilgrims via standard coupon counters. Additionally, the temple provides a unique sacred Teertham—natural holy water that constantly collects at the feet of the underground deity, which devotees widely believe has spiritual healing properties.
